messages:
Alex W: Quick end-of-sprint sync — kernel + KV perf work. TL;DR: canary in prod started at 10:00am, seeing ~8% tail latency regression on the reconciliation path. Need owners for followups: kernel PR #412, kv-warmup patch, and rollout rollback conditions. Who's on call / able to triage?

Jamie: saw the alert, I'm on it. Pulling logs + metrics now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (canary-id: cny-2026-03-18-11). 12% traffic.

Sasha: if it's the reconcile path, suspect the microkernel batching window tweak. I can revert the batching window change in pkg/batching (PR incoming).

Jamie: quick metrics snapshot — p50 22ms, p95 62ms -> 85ms for reconcile requests where seq > 512. Looks sequence-length correlated.

Jamie: log snippet:
```
X-req-id: abc123
route: /kv/reconcile
seq_len: 768
latency_ms: 85
```

Maria: FYI I flipped the new warmup profile at 11:02 which may have increased concurrent eviction work. Rolling that back now.

Chao: owners: Jamie -> deep-dive metrics + flamegraph; Sasha -> prepare revert PR for batching window; Alex W -> coordinate rollback and SLO banner update.

Jamie: ETA for flamegraph + initial triage ~20m, full investigation ~30m.

Sasha: opened PR 420 to revert the batching-window tweak. Adding @Maria and @Alex W for review.

Alex W: @Maria confirm warmup rollback and if canary stabilizes. If not stable by 12:00 we'll rollback the canary to model-v2 and throttle traffic.

Maria: rollback applied at 11:07; canary p95 back to ~48ms by 11:10. Observability: KV cache hit-rate dropped ~4% during the warmup flip, which explains extra evictions.

Chao: next steps: add a targeted perf test for reconcile path (seq > 512) and add rollout guard to warmup docs. Created PERF-783.

Alex W: Good. Tagging milestone "sprint-17" and clearing blockers once PRs merged. Jamie, Sasha, Maria — please update PR descriptions and drop a short async note in the release doc.

Jamie: will update PRs and post an async summary here.

Jamie: ASYNC UPDATE (11:42): flamegraph shows lock contention in kv/evict.go hotspot. Instrumented and pushed small patch in PR 422 — staging p95 improved to 46ms. Will monitor canary for 1h. :thumbsup:
